title: feat: official motor usage × racer registration cohort previous-meet audit
body:
## Facts matched from primary sources
- BOAT RACE Hamanako motor #12 official usage history: Aug 21–26 2026 Narita Haruto (成田華音), Sept 19–24 Shibuya Akinori, Sept 30–Oct 4 Tsuge Masahiro.
- BOAT RACE official racer profile matches Narita registration #5466, 138th cohort; official training announcement places 138th cohort debut in May 2026.
- Historical case: entering Sept 19 meet, previous recorded user was the newly debuted cohort racer; his Aug meet 0 top-two finishes from 9 starts, next user 5 top-two finishes from 11 starts including final (5/10 excluding final).

## Code
- Offline motor-history text/HTML table parser, strict motor identity, exact normalized racer name + official racer ID/entry cohort join.
- Historical previous recorded meet detection and cohort-debut-month proxy, incomplete/ambiguous sources flagged as unknown.
- Tests use a short manually curated excerpt of primary-source facts, NOT raw official HTML. Local no-scraping CLI added.
- Never treat retrospective source snapshots as available at a historical pre-race cutoff.

## Limitations
Only motor #12 / Hamanako confirmed in this proof of concept; no full-venue harvesting or direct official file ingestion tested. Profile date is a cohort-level debut approximation, not an individual's exact debut. Raw official HTML compatibility and event-level B/K reconciliation unverified. Prior PR #1–#3 are still Draft and unmerged. No live use or merge before CI and independent review.
